name: Lantern Button
description: A paper lantern with wooden rims that lights from inside when hovered, with the faint unsteadiness of a flame.

props.name: lit
props.description: Holds the light on. Otherwise it lights on hover, keyboard focus and press.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the light. The paper glows from a pale core to a deeper edge of this colour.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Icon before the label. Sized to 16 pixels.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard. The light brightens for a moment.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button.
